episode: Mind Asset (Itaú Asset Management), 'Fundos multimercado: IA, alternativos e o futuro da gestão'
labeller: Claude (build session, 16 Oct 2026), by hand, before thresholds were computed; Bernardo to spot-check (evals/cards/labels.md)
label_rules:
written by hand, one by one, by the session that built
the test set (16 Oct 2026), before any threshold was computed:
  quote_faithful  - the quote carries the speaker's own words and meaning; filler words, repeated words and
                    ASR misspellings may differ; a changed name, number, negation or hedge, a paraphrase, a
                    translation, a splice or a span cut so it drops a qualifier is NOT faithful.
  claim_supported - the claim follows from the quote alone (context from elsewhere = not supported).
